title: Sudan sanctions regime expires — the deadline resolution 2828's technical rollover created, four weeks after it was adopted
source: NEWS: english.news.cn/20260912/7f4f2867b13148e7aa4f9899d218aac1/c.html (Xinhua), fetched direct 2026-09-15 (HTTP 200) during the unsc-haiti-gsf-mandate-expiry-2026-09-30 initial research, which was surveying Security Council technical-rollover practice. The report states that resolution 2828, 'adopted unanimously by the 15-member council' on 11 September 2026, extends the Sudan sanctions regime - an arms embargo plus targeted travel-ban and asset-freeze measures - 'until Oct. 9, 2026', and separately extends the Panel of Experts mandate 'until Nov. 9, 2026'. Corroborated in outline by securitycouncilreport.org and by sudantribune.com/article/318628, both of which describe the September 2026 Sudan action as a short-term technical rollover taken to allow more time for negotiations. Estimate rather than confirmed on two grounds: CONFIRMED_PREFIX in scripts/event-scan-validation.mjs carries no UN or diplomatic slot, and the resolution's own operative text was not fetched - the date here is quoted from a news report of it, which is why the prefix is NEWS: rather than EST:. Checked 2026-09-15
notes: PROPOSED, NOT CANONICAL - the proposing lane owns this file and never writes another event's canonical entry (#1717). WHY IT WAS DISCOVERED HERE: the Haiti GSF expiry ledger needed a base rate for what the Council does when a mandate renewal stalls, and the technical rollover is the answer; res 2828 is the most recent instance and it manufactured a new dated deadline four weeks out. That deadline is the definition of a rollover - a short extension adopted to buy negotiating time - so it is a genuinely live re-decision point rather than a formality, and it is the reason this is worth a calendar row at all. WHY low AND symbols [] ARE THE HONEST FILING, stated so a later lane does not have to re-derive it: this book tracks no listed Sudanese instrument, and Sudan's channel to any tracked name is indirect (gum arabic supply chains reach consumer-staples formulations; Red Sea routing already prices through the Yemen/Hormuz complex, which the crude and shipping names carry on their own). A sanctions-regime deadline changes neither. THE DATED SIBLING NOT PROPOSED HERE: the same resolution extends the Sudan Panel of Experts to 2026-11-09, one month later. It is deliberately left unfiled - it sits outside the 60-day horizon question this sweep was answering and a later lane researching THIS entry is better placed to file it with its own reading of res 2828. WHAT WOULD FIRM THE DATE: resolution 2828's operative paragraph on main.un.org or press.un.org, which would also settle whether the measures deadline is 2026-10-09 or the last business day before it (2026-10-09 is a Friday, so the two coincide).
